bindings.description: Which mode serves each interface, as interface name: binding; one major per project in 5.0.0.

adapter.description: The adapter that runs skill steps.

modes.description: Kit modes this project uses; its own modes, and the modes they bind, are used anyway.

settings.description: Settings per mode, as mode name: settings; each is checked against the mode's settings schema.

budget.description: The default limits for a run that sets none of its own.

approvals.description: Where the owner may decide approvals.

from.description: The channels approve accepts; without this setting only terminal.

items.description: A channel the owner approves from.

binding.description: A mode name, which serves every mode that requires the interface, or a map from requiring mode to serving mode with an optional default for the requiring modes it does not name.

bindingMap.description: Requiring mode name: serving mode name; the key default serves every requiring mode not named.

name.description: Kebab-case, starting with a letter; not constructor, a name every JavaScript object has.

budget.description: Limits for a run; every nested call draws from the same budget.

items.description: The most items the run may handle.

usd.description: The most US dollars the run may spend.

tokens.description: The most model tokens the run may use.

minutes.description: The most minutes the run may take.
